title: Ton en tede te biblo periechomenon onomata kai taxis = Eorum quae in hoc libro continentur, nomina & ordo
shelf_note: The opening of Theophrastus' Historia plantarum in the Aldine Greek edition (1497), which belongs in the biodiversity / chicagobotanic collections. The catalogue title is the volume's contents list, and the display title 'Enquiry into Plants' names only one work in a composite volume. That does not make the shelf wrong.

book_verdict: The right leaf, from the 1497 Aldine Theophrastus. The OCR is serviceable, but it misreads several Aldine ligatures, which removes one comparative and the words 'old age'. The translation is faithful to the OCR, and its notes are mostly sound: two add interpretation the page does not carry, but neither is serious.
